scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build -w @takolo/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @takolo/shared && npm run dev -w @takolo/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @takolo/shared && npm run dev -w @takolo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @takolo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @takolo/api && npm run typecheck -w @takolo/web && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json
scripts.build:backend: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @takolo/shared && npm run build -w @takolo/api && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json
